dbd_uniprot.tsv.note: DBD spans extracted from the raw download

dbd_choice_rule.2: longest DOMAIN feature whose note matches HTH/helix-turn-helix
dbd_choice_rule.3: short DNA_BIND motif widened to a 60 aa window
dbd_choice_rule.4: full chain when unannotated and <= 200 aa (compact)
dbd_choice_rule.5: full chain, longer than the compact cap - not imported

excluded_note: chains longer than the 200 aa compact cap with no annotated DBD are multi-domain enzymes whose chain is not a binding domain; composite-entry subunits are resolved in the snapshot but not written, because one cell cannot hold two sequences
